description: Header file defining the IPCThreadState class for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including methods for managing thread-specific binder state, process freeze info, and transaction handling.

classes.name: IPCThreadState
classes.description: Manages thread-specific state for Android's binder IPC, including process freeze control, transaction handling, and security context.

methods.name: self
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IPCThreadState.

methods.name: selfOrNull
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance or null if not instantiated.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Freezes or unfreezes binder transactions for a specific process.

methods.name: getProcessFreezeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves freeze info for a process.

methods.name: clearLastError
methods.description: Clears the last error state.

methods.name: getCallingPid
methods.description: Returns the PID of the process making the current binder call.

methods.name: getCallingSid
methods.description: Returns the SELinux security identifier of the caller.

methods.name: getCallingUid
methods.description: Returns the UID of the caller process.

methods.name: pushGetCallingSpGuard
methods.description: Pushes a guard object to enforce getCalling* API usage.

methods.name: restoreGetCallingSpGuard
methods.description: Restores the previous guard object.

methods.name: checkContextIsBinderForUse
methods.description: Asserts that current context is a binder context.

methods.name: setStrictModePolicy
methods.description: Sets strict mode policy.

methods.name: getStrictModePolicy
methods.description: Gets strict mode policy.

methods.name: setCallingWorkSourceUid
methods.description: Sets the work source UID for resource attribution.

methods.name: getCallingWorkSourceUid
methods.description: Gets the current work source UID.

methods.name: clearCallingWorkSource
methods.description: Clears the work source UID.

methods.name: restoreCallingWorkSource
methods.description: Restores the work source UID from a token.

methods.name: setLastTransactionBinderFlags
methods.description: Sets binder flags for the last transaction.

methods.name: getLastTransactionBinderFlags
methods.description: Gets binder flags for the last transaction.

methods.name: setCallRestriction
methods.description: Sets call restriction policy.

methods.name: getCallRestriction
methods.description: Gets current call restriction policy.

methods.name: clearCallingIdentity
methods.description: Clears the calling identity.

methods.name: restoreCallingIdentity
methods.description: Restores calling identity from a token.

methods.name: hasExplicitIdentity
methods.description: Checks if explicit identity is set.

methods.name: setupPolling
methods.description: Sets up polling for IPC.

methods.name: handlePolledCommands
methods.description: Handles polled commands.

methods.name: flushCommands
methods.description: Flushes IPC commands.

methods.name: flushIfNeeded
methods.description: Flushes if required.

methods.name: joinThreadPool
methods.description: Joins the binder thread pool.

methods.name: stopProcess
methods.description: Stops the local process.

methods.name: transact
methods.description: Performs an IPC transaction.

methods.name: incStrongHandle
methods.description: Increments strong handle reference.

methods.name: decStrongHandle
methods.description: Decrements strong handle reference.

methods.name: incWeakHandle
methods.description: Increments weak handle reference.

methods.name: decWeakHandle
methods.description: Decrements weak handle reference.

methods.name: attemptIncStrongHandle
methods.description: Attempts to increment strong handle reference.

methods.name: expungeHandle
methods.description: Removes handle association.

methods.name: requestDeathNotification
methods.description: Requests death notification for a handle.

methods.name: clearDeathNotification
methods.description: Clears death notification for a handle.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down IPCThreadState.

methods.name: disableBackgroundScheduling
methods.description: Disables background scheduling for IPC.

methods.name: backgroundSchedulingDisabled
methods.description: Checks if background scheduling is disabled.

methods.name: blockUntilThreadAvailable
methods.description: Blocks until a binder thread is available.

methods.name: setTheContextObject
methods.description: Sets the context object for the service.

methods.name: getServingStackPointer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the last kernel-initiated transaction stack.
